name: William Ball
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: UNPROVEN: known only from the Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree (Irma Kulp Zacher), which cites other member trees. Born 1784 at Alexandria, Virginia; died 1826 in Hawkins County, Tennessee; son of Moses Ball and Mary Ann Hardin. Father of David Tate Ball.
